attempted_claim: For each d in {15, 23, 31, 39, 47} let K_d = Q(sqrt(-d)), O_d its ring of integers, X_d = Spec O_d minus S_d where S_d is the finite set of primes dividing 2 disc(K_d), let L_d = K_d(i) with associated quadratic Kummer character rho_d: pi_1^{et}(X_d) -> Z/2, and let c be the normalized generator of H^3(Z/2, Q/Z) congruent to Z/2. Determine with proof, for all five d, the exact Kim-Hirano mod-2 arithmetic Chern-Simons invariant CS_c(rho_d) in {0, 1/2}. A complete answer is the full five-entry table of exact values, each entry supported by an explicit etale 3-cocycle evaluation certificate (cup-product/Artin-symbol computation with all ramification accounted for); partial tables or numerical approximations without cocycle proof do not count.
claim_type: five-entry exact invariant table with cocycle certificates
decisive_failure: No complete five-entry table is claimed because each character L_d/K_d ramifies at the two 2-adic places, disqualifying the unramified exact formulas, while the applicable ramified certificate path needs odd-ramified C4 lifts and class-field software unavailable in-lane; the worklog records the attempted routes and the bounded recovery probe so a follow-on lane need not repeat them.
